U_is_observed_maximum: partial-source U is a lower-bound observed target, not guaranteed true maximum
capture: observed strictly later hit confirmed; absent hit on incomplete remaining source =>unknown
fill: first available regular raw open at start>=intent +5bps; exclude actual 09:00/12:30 mixed opening starts; no 30-minute cap

heads.D: absolute min(0,min Low/fill-1) from fill bar through peak bar inclusive; train clip 0..5; complete scheduled-source path required
heads.Q: fill + closed closes including fill bar through earliest strictly later max-High bar; max(net close progress,0)/total variation; TV=0 =>0; complete scheduled-source path required
heads.U: strictly later raw-bar-start maximum observed High / fill; raw percent saved; training clip 0..10

lunch_and_closing_auction_pause: not active; expected dated RC2 source schedule, including terminal marks, otherwise no inserted bar
missing_path: Q and D targets NULL; observed raw statistics separately saved, no interpolation across missing scheduled minute
peak: earliest raw bar attaining observed maximum High; exact touch time and intrabar order unknown
primary_winner_denominator: saved canonical first-selector full-session MFE, reused; continuous 1m completeness separate
strictly_later: maximum over raw source start>fill_minute; same fill-bar High excluded
